Subject: MAP & legal sequencing runbook — Nimbus pilot

Alexa — attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a concise legal/procurement sequencing runbook for the Nimbus pilot. High-level ask: can you confirm the internal owners and whether Nimbus can target an initial sandbox provision on or before Aug 24 while legal/procurement run to signature?

Summary of the plan (see attached MAP v1.3 for full milestones):
- Week 0 (Aug 3): MAP drafted; identify procurement/legal owners and required evidence (SOC2, DPA redlines).
- Week 1 (Aug 10): Legal/Redwood intake + questions; DPA markup exchange.
- Week 2 (by Aug 20): Target MSA signature if both sides accept standard terms; DPA can run in parallel.
- Week 3 (Aug 24–28): Order form + PO/finance; sandbox provisioning and SSO setup after minimal acceptance.
- Contingency: if PO delayed > Aug 28, we can enable a time-limited eval environment under an interim eval order form.

Critical dependencies called out in the MAP: MSA redline completion, DPA acceptance, PO & billing contact, and security questionnaire answers (we included a short security evidence checklist in the runbook). Please review and confirm: 1) who on your side owns procurement, legal and security; 2) whether Nimbus needs any contract amendments (SLA, data residency); 3) whether your timeline constraints require acceleration.

Attachments: Nimbus_MAP_v1.3.xlsx (master MAP), redwood-procurement-checklist.pdf (checklist).

Thanks — I can hop on a short alignment call this week. Proposed time: Wed Aug 5 10:00–10:30 PDT.

— Rachel Kim

Rachel — thanks for the quick turnaround and the MAP. This looks useful. A few notes from procurement/legal here:

- Procurement owner: Alex Rivera (cc'd). He handles POs and billing cadence.
- Legal reviewer: Emily Chen (not cc'd yet; will loop her if things look standard).
- Security: we have a small security intake team; they will need SOC2 evidence + a short questionnaire answered (we'll send the form).

Timeline constraints: our execs want pilots running by Sept 1. That puts pressure on us to get the MSA and DPA finalized quickly. Realistically, internal legal wants two weeks for a first pass on the MSA once they have your standard terms; procurement needs budget signoff for a PO which could take 7–14 days after legal sign-off.

Two quick asks: can Redwood accept a short-term eval order form for sandboxing if we commit to signature afterwards? And can you confirm whether DPA redlines would be handled in parallel or require the MSA to be finalized first?

I'll aim to get Emily into the thread tomorrow.

— Alexa

Alexa — great, thanks for the clarity. Looping Ben & Laura to confirm Redwood-side owners and to call out gating items.

Quick responses to your asks:
- Eval order form: yes, we can provision a time-limited eval/sandbox under a short-form order (we've used this successfully before). We will require the DPA in place for any environment with customer data; if you prefer a synthetic-data sandbox we can be more flexible.
- DPA vs MSA: Redwood's preference is to run DPA redlines in parallel with the MSA to avoid serial delays. Laura (cc) will handle DPA intake and can accept edits in parallel.

Proposed Redwood owners:
- AE / commercial: Ben Carter (contract & PO liaison)
- Legal intake / DPA: Laura Bennett (legal ops)
- Solutions lead: Rachel Kim (technical onboarding/runbook owner)

Gating checklist (short):
1) Legal redlines accepted or limited to a small set of negotiable clauses (data residency, liability cap).
2) DPA approved and signed (can be signature-ready before MSA final in parallel).
3) PO or payment commitment for order form or interim eval order.
4) Security questionnaire completed + SOC2 attestation link.

I'm available for the Wed Aug 5 10:00 slot; Ben and Laura can join as needed. Attached is the Redwood procurement checklist to help accelerate internal approvals.

— Rachel
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Alexa — happy to prioritize Nimbus. Quick operational commitments from Redwood side:
- We can target MSA signature by Aug 20 if your legal can get a first pass back within 7 business days of receiving our standard terms.
- DPA can be processed in parallel; Laura will consolidate redlines.
- Sandbox provisioning: we can stand up a sandbox environment within 48 hours of a signed eval order form or a purchase order that commits to pilot spend (we're flexible on whether you use an interim PO or a short-form eval order).

Question for Alex Rivera: what does Nimbus's PO timeline typically look like for pilots (internal approvals, PO issuance)? If PO timing is tighter than Aug 24 we should consider the interim eval order approach.

Ben/Rachel — quick update from procurement side after internal check:
- PO cadence: we need budget committee approval before a PO can be issued; that committee meets Aug 18 and it is likely the earliest a PO could be approved is Aug 20–24. So Aug 24 for sandbox provisioning is plausible but not guaranteed.
- Legal: Emily (cc) will start with your standard MSA; she'll send comments by Aug 13.
- Security questionnaire: we'll send that today; please return within 3 business days if possible.

Request: can Redwood provision a limited, non-production sandbox on Aug 24 under an interim eval order that restricts data ingestion to synthetic records and excludes SSO/PII exports until the DPA is fully signed? That would allow Nimbus teams to start integration testing.

If you can accept that constraint, we should be able to keep to the Sep 1 pilot kickoff.

— Alexa
